core_tradeoff: Attacks compact the horde around their geometry

trigger.condition: pull applies on every damaging weapon hit; clustered-damage bonus applies while an enemy is within the displayed clustering distance of at least one other living enemy

acquisition.method: found in a relic cache through map exploration
acquisition.cache_opening: automatic on mech contact; freezes the complete gameplay simulation
acquisition.resolution: immediate install-or-sell; no relic inventory or deferred decision

rarity_and_weighting.selection_model: three distinct relics drawn without replacement from the currently unlocked pool and assigned to the three caches during generation

stacking_and_exclusivity.modifier_order: Relic-specific multipliers apply after the additive percentage modifiers supplied by mech traits, utilities, and PowerUps unless the relic explicitly replaces targeting or cadence.

behavior_registration.hook: per-hit pull and clustered target multiplier
behavior_registration.registration_model: Relics are cross-cutting policies registered by stable relic ID. They modify well-defined hook points rather than scattering ID checks through every weapon.
behavior_registration.per_weapon_compatibility_manifest: produced from tests; states fully affected, partially affected with disclosed reason, or invalid. The initial design expects no invalid pairing.

rules.text: Every damaging weapon hit applies an inward displacement toward the nearest meaningful centerline, impact point, field center, projectile path, or other visible center of that attack's geometry.
Existing weapon-authored knockback reverses into pull instead of applying both directions. Non-displacement control such as slow or stun remains unchanged.
An enemy within the displayed clustering distance of at least one other living enemy takes 50% more weapon damage.
Pull resistance continues to scale for elites and bosses, but the clustered-damage rule applies whenever their spatial condition is satisfied.
The relic makes piercing, area, and persistent attacks exceptionally effective while intentionally compacting pursuers into more dangerous concentrations.

cross_document_rules.rule: Apply target-state multipliers such as Barysteel resonance or Event-Horizon clustering.
cross_document_rules.meaning: clustered-damage bonus resolves at step 3 of the enemy/rock damage pipeline, after source-side relic reductions or amplification
